environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 only). The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the application via nginx reverse proxy. No application-layer inspection is performed. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs directly with gunicorn, no middleware filtering. The SQLite database contains production user records including admin API keys and password hashes accessible via UNION-based injection.
